name: Ronak Purohit
summary:
Dynamic Senior IT Auditor with
extensive experience in Integrated
Statutory Audits and SOX 404
Compliance. Expert in evaluating
ITGC, ITAC, and SDLC controls
across SAP, Oracle, and various
Non-SAP applications. Specialized

analysis, SOC 1/SOC 2 assessments,
and BCP/DR resilience testing.

in bridging the gap between
technology risks and financial
statement integrity through rigorous
IPE validation.
